text: Dashboard Amend recognizes any `^fixup!\\s+` subject. Ordinary local fixups require exactly one parent directly above a matching target subject; they reuse transactional commit reconstruction, guarded ref updates, descendant replay, original messages, and resumable recovery, but must not invent Try records/results.
